ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels covering central and interior lobe regions, 25% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated on trailing edges and central junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields across both lobes. Continuous black pigmentation band along the trailing edges. Vertical black linear streaks on the right lobe interior. High-density black mottling at the base where lobes meet the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; approximately 40-50 degree pixel angle at the vertex with significant bounding-box depth relative to horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) are most pronounced at the distal lobe tips and maintain moderate frequency along the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly convex curvature on the outer edges; lobes sweep upward and outward from the median notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular tan/white pixel groups (barnacles) visible along the distal trailing edges and at the lobe tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical and diagonal unaligned linear pixel disruptions (dark streaks) crossing the white ventral pigmentation, particularly visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present on the trailing edges and lobe tips; parallel vertical rake marks visible on the interior white surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical 'rake' pattern consisting of three to four parallel dark lines on the interior white surface of the right lobe lobes.
